Pre-sale inspection notes - Satamakatu 8 B 24, Helsinki
Inspector: Mikko Laine, 9 April 2026

Roof
- The roof underlay is the original from 1998 and is brittle at the eaves.
- Two roof hatch seals are worn. Rainwater stains on the attic floor below the south slope.

Bathroom
- Moisture reading in the wall behind the bath: 18 % (normal is below 12 %).
- The silicone joints are cracked around the bath.

Plumbing
- The copper supply pipes in the kitchen are in good condition.
- The pipes inside the walls could not be checked.
